jobs.excerpt: Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus.
jobs.description:
Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen.

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit.

KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt kombiniert mit einer leistungsorientierten und überdurchschnittlichen Gewinnbeteiligung erhalten möchtest.
  • du flexibel und ortsunabhängig arbeiten willst und gleichzeitig an hochrelevanten Projekten in den Bereichen Cyber Security, IT Security und KI-Sicherheit mitwirken möchtest.
  • du durch anspruchsvolle Projekte tiefgehende Expertise in modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen, Security Operations, Risikomanagement und technologischen Zusammenhängen aufbauen und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.

Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von Sicherheitsaudits und Gap-Analysen nach ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz und NIS2
  • Begleitung von Unternehmen bei der Vorbereitung auf KRITIS-Prüfungen und BSI-Nachweise gemäß §39 BSIG
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Informationssicherheits-Managementsystemen (ISMS)
  • Beratung zur Umsetzung der NIS2-Anforderungen: Risikomanagement, Meldepflichten, Lieferkettensicherheit, Geschäftsführerhaftung
  • Durchführung von TISAX-Assessments für Unternehmen in der Automobilzulieferkette
  • Erstellung von Risikobewertungen, Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Nachweisdokumentationen
  • Beratung zum Zusammenspiel von NIS2, DSGVO und branchenspezifischen Regulierungen (EnWG, TKG, DORA für Finanzsektor)
  • Beratung zur Umsetzung des EU AI Act: Risikoklassifizierung von KI-Systemen, Konformitätsbewertungen und Dokumentationspflichten
  • Unterstützung bei der Erfüllung der Anforderungen des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) für Hersteller und Importeure digitaler Produkte
  • Schulung von Geschäftsführungen und Führungskräften zu ihren Pflichten unter NIS2 (§38 BSIG)

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Sicherheitsaudit, Compliance oder ISMS-Beratung
  • Zertifizierung als ISO 27001 Lead Auditor oder Lead Implementer (zwingend erforderlich)
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des BSI IT-Grundschutz-Kompendiums und der BSI-Standards 200-1/200-2/200-3/200-4
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit KRITIS-Prüfungen und/oder NIS2-Umsetzungsprojekten
  • Kenntnisse des EU AI Act (Risikoklassifizierung, Hochrisiko-KI-Systeme) und des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) sind ein starkes Plus
  • Kenntnisse in TISAX und VDA ISA sind ein weiterer Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikobewertungen und der Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten
  • Verständnis für die Verzahnung von technischen und organisatorischen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (zwingend) und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Fixgehalt ab 80.000 € mit Gewinnbeteiligung bis zu 70.000 €
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Arbeit
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • IT-Equipment wie Apple MacBook
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Corporate Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Shopping- und Mitarbeiterrabatte

Werde Teil von APT-ONE und mach Sicherheit zu deiner Mission

Senior Data Science Engineer/Specialist

Concurrent Technologies Corporation

Remote

Minimum Clearance Required: None

Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: Secret

Employee Background Check Required

CTC Engineering and Manufacturing: Where Cutting-Edge Innovation Meets Mission-Critical Solutions

The CTC Engineering Division specializes in transforming cutting-edge technologies into real-world solutions. We harness the power of 3D printing, advanced joining techniques like friction stir welding, and cutting-edge design tools to tackle complex challenges for a diverse set of clients.

As a Senior Data Science Engineer/Specialist, you will serve as a technical leader, applying advanced data science and mathematical techniques to solve complex and mission-critical challenges for Department of Defense (DoD) clients. You will lead projects, mentor junior staff, and drive the development of innovative solutions that enhance decision-making and operational efficiency. This role requires a high degree of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership and Project Management:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex data science and mathematics projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives and timelines.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level team members, fostering their professional growth.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define project requirements, scope, and deliverables.
  • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure the successful completion of projects.

Advanced Data Analysis and Modeling:

  • Design and implement advanced statistical, predictive, and machine learning models to address complex client challenges.
  • Perform sophisticated exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify actionable insights and inform decision-making.
  • Develop and refine mathematical models for simulation, optimization, and forecasting tasks.

Algorithm Development and Innovation:

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of algorithms for data processing, analysis, and modeling.
  • Validate and deploy algorithms in operational environments, ensuring scalability and reliability.
  • Drive innovation by researching and applying cutting-edge techniques in data science, artificial intelligence, and mathematics.

Tool and Technology Utilization:

  • Utilize advanced programming skills in Python, R, MATLAB, or similar languages to develop custom solutions.
  • Leverage data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib) to create compelling and actionable insights.
  • Integrate data science workflows into enterprise systems and processes to enhance operational efficiency.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates and ensuring satisfaction with deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality technical reports, presentations, and documentation for diverse audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project goals.

Research and Development:

  • Lead research initiatives to explore emerging data science techniques, tools, and technologies.
  • Develop innovative methodologies and frameworks to address evolving client needs.
  • Publish findings and contribute to the broader data science and mathematics community.

Support for DoD Projects:

  • Provide expert analysis and recommendations to support DoD mission objectives and strategic decision-making.
  • Develop and implement advanced tools, processes, and methodologies to improve operational capabilities for DoD clients.
  • Ensure all deliverables comply with DoD standards, policies, and security requirements.

Concurrent Technologies Corporation (CTC) is preparing to stand up a dedicated team to manage a new, high-priority initiative for the U.S. Navy. This is a unique opportunity to help revitalize and strengthen a critical national security industrial base. As the manager of a large portfolio of innovative projects under a flexible contracting vehicle, CTC will be at the center of this mission. Our role will be to connect cutting-edge solutions from across industry and academia to the Navy's most pressing challenges, accelerating technology adoption and ensuring our nation's defense industrial base has the capacity and capability for decades to come. This is a fast-paced, dynamic program where you will play a foundational role in its success. We are seeking talented professionals to join us in this exciting and impactful work.

As a Senior Data Science Engineer, you will transform vast streams of project data into actionable intelligence and strategic insights for government leadership. You will develop the dashboards, analytics, and reports that provide radical transparency into the performance and impact of this national security program.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in data science, mathematics, or related fields.
  • Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, MATLAB, or similar.
  • Strong expertise in statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and mathematical modeling.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib) and data engineering concepts.
  • Proven ability to lead projects, manage teams, and deliver high-quality results.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Advanced knowledge of database systems (e.g., SQL, NoSQL) and cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Experience working in DoD or government contracting environments, with a strong understanding of DoD standards and policies.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.
  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and distributed computing frameworks.

Work Environment/Conditions:

  • Determined by management if applicable.

Why CTC?

  • Mastering the future of manufacturing: Be at the forefront of technological advancements in advanced manufacturing.
  • Innovate for impact: Your work will push the boundaries of what's possible, from next-generation armaments to groundbreaking environmental solutions that directly impact critical missions and the lives of those protecting our country.
  • Work alongside the best: Collaborate with a passionate team of engineers and scientists, united by a shared drive to excel and a commitment to delivering outstanding results.
  • Leave your mark: CTC is more than just a job. It's a launchpad for your engineering dreams.
  • · Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • · Although our work at CTC is extremely important, we also recognize the need for our employees to maintain a proper mix of work and personal life.
  • · Visit to learn more.

Join us! CTC offers exceptional career growth, cutting edge technology, educational opportunities, and recognition for quality work.

jobs.excerpt: Syntropic ScribeKalungi is hiring a Syntropy Scribe.
jobs.description:
Syntropic Scribe

Kalungi is hiring a Syntropy Scribe.

This is a senior content strategist and writer role, but at Kalungi, the work doesn’t start with writing.

As a Kalungi Scribe, work begins with people, not keywords. We extract insight from founders, customers, and the market, then turn that insight into clear narratives and high-impact content for B2B SaaS GTM.

We don’t start from briefs or prompts; we start from interviews, research, and pattern recognition. SEO-friendly and high-converting content that ranks is the result of our Scribe work.

We use AI because it can help with drafting and speed, but AI can’t decide what matters. That’s our job.

What you’ll do

1. Extract human signal

  • Run interviews with founders, customers, sales teams, and subject-matter experts
  • Mine calls, transcripts, win/loss notes, and field conversations for non-obvious insights
  • Identify patterns, tensions, and language buyers actually use, not what tools infer

2. Turn insight into narrative and positioning

  • Translate raw signal into clear positioning, messaging, and POVs for B2B SaaS companies
  • Create messaging and positioning guides teams can use across marketing and sales
  • Partner with the Syntropy Navigator (CMO) to ensure narrative clarity drives GTM strategy

3. Write and shape high-impact content

  • Website copy (core pages, positioning, use cases)
  • Long-form content like webinars, lead magnets, guides, and narrative-driven reports
  • Blog content grounded in original insight, not recycled opinion
  • Ad copy and landing page copy that reflects real buyer language
  • Founder and customer stories
  • Social and distribution content that carries signal, not fluff

4. Repurpose with intent

  • Turn interviews, webinars, and long-form assets into cohesive content systems
  • Repurpose insight across blogs, social, email, and sales enablement — without diluting the core narrative
  • Ensure every derivative asset reinforces the same story

5. Use AI to accelerate, not replace, thinking

  • Use AI tools to support research, synthesis, drafting, and repurposing
  • Set up prompts, workflows, and content libraries that speed up production while preserving voice and signal
  • Act as the editor-in-chief: refining, correcting, and deciding what should not be automated.

What this role is not

This role is not:

  • A keyword-first SEO content role
  • A blog factory or content ops position
  • Prompt-only AI writing or ghostwriting
  • A volume or velocity output function

What we’re looking for

You likely have experience in content strategy, writing, journalism, research, product marketing, or strategy, ideally in B2B SaaS.

You are:

  • A strong interviewer who knows how to ask the question behind the question
  • A sharp synthesizer who can turn complexity into simple, precise language
  • A confident writer who values clarity over cleverness
  • Comfortable shaping messaging, positioning, and narrative, not just executing briefs
  • Fluent enough in B2B SaaS to recognize real signal versus surface-level noise
  • Experienced using AI tools as support, without outsourcing judgment to them

We care more about how you think than the tools you’ve used.

How you’ll know you’re succeeding

You’re winning when:

  • Founders and clients say, “That’s exactly what we’re seeing, we just hadn’t named it.”
  • Messaging and positioning become clearer and more consistent across channels
  • Content performs better because it’s grounded in real insight, not tactics
  • Sales, marketing, and leadership pull from the same narrative source of truth
  • AI-assisted content improves because the underlying thinking is strong

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Fully remote work environment
  • The opportunity to shape the future of how agencies work in the age of AI

A Note on Video Introductions & Cover Letters

At Kalungi, we value syntropy - bringing order, clarity, and purpose to the work we do. Your cover letter and video introduction are your first opportunity to do the same: to shape a clear, intentional story about who you are and how you create impact. The video doesn't have to be elaborate! Get out your phone and take a spontaneous "selfie video". Don't overthink it. Applicants who have lackluster cover letters or who fail to provide a video intro will be disqualified.

About Kalungi

Kalungi helps B2B SaaS companies grow through full-spectrum marketing—from strategy and positioning to campaign management and optimization. We bring proven frameworks, mentorship, and an entrepreneurial spirit to every client engagement.

We’re excited to learn more about you—and the stories you can help us tell.

– The Kalungi Team

Kalungi is an equal-opportunity employer. Employment at Kalungi is based solely on a person's qualifications directly related to professional competence. Kalungi does not discriminate against any applicant because of age, disability, gender, race, religion, or any other basis protected by law.

The Role

Are you ready to level up? Do you want to get fast-tracked to become a marketing leader? If you have a background in marketing and want to gain hands-on experience in creating and implementing strategic marketing initiatives for B2B SaaS ventures, you’ve come to the right place.

This is a rare opportunity to learn and gain experience in B2B SaaS marketing while making a daily impact on companies experiencing exponential growth. At Kalungi, you will support one of our Chief Marketing Officers as they create and execute marketing strategies for software companies to accelerate their growth. You will be given real and impactful responsibilities that directly impact our clients’ bottom line while gaining knowledge in areas that range from high-level marketing strategy to the nuts and bolts of execution. The ultimate goal of this position is to set you on a course to become a marketing leader who can lead teams, develop and present marketing strategies to executive teams and implement those strategies to drive exponential growth.

Responsibilities

In this role you will:

  • Complete projects to support inbound, outbound and strategic marketing initiatives;
  • Conduct competitive research to influence positioning decisions and marketing campaigns;
  • Perform marketing attribution, connecting leads to dollars so we can show marketing’s impact;
  • Conduct SEO research, giving our content production efforts direction and maximizing their effectiveness;
  • Create Google, Facebook, & Linkedin ad campaigns to increase search authority, website traffic, and leads;
  • Develop and maintain content for inbound- and outbound campaigns; and
  • Assist with project coordination and marketing campaign execution.

What we’re looking for

Working on the Kalungi team means embracing self-improvement. We don’t expect perfection, but attention to detail, endless curiosity, humility and the desire to level up fast. We own our work by seeking responsibility and accountability for the ideas we create. We ask "Why?" a lot, and share our goals and experiences to challenge our thinking. We uncover impactful insights that raise our clients to new levels.

Our Ideal Candidate:

  • Education/Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent working experience
  • 2-3 years of marketing experience (ppc, copywriting, marketing management, etc.)
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office & Google Suite (experience with Hubspot is a plus)
  • An entrepreneurial spirit with a marketing “superpower” that can add immediate value
  • Systems and process-thinker; loves creating order out of chaos
  • Curious and eager to learn; always looking for ways to level up
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills
  • A creative mind with keen attention to detail
  • Focused on adding value to every touch point, process, project or task they are a part of
  • Have a strong background in writing and be able to write concise, punchy copy that incorporates complex meaning simply and understandably
  • Have an eye for design and be able to format clean, presentable deliverables.

About Kalungi

Kalungi was founded to focus specifically on business-to-business (B2B) Software-as-a-Service (Saas) companies. Unlike most agencies, who focus on only a few aspects of marketing, Kalungi owns the full spectrum, from marketing strategy and positioning to campaign management and website optimization. Kalungi brings extensive experience in leadership, strategic direction, and a clear ‘B2B SaaS Success Blueprint’ proven to generate millions of dollars in attributed revenue for clients around the world. Kalungi prides itself on mentorship, education, and an entrepreneurial spirit to take on new challenges and improve every day.

Company Values

At Kalungi, we want to stand for more than just the outcomes of our daily work. How we do our work, who we work with and why we do this, is critical. Here areour core valuesto keep us grounded as a company. We apply these for hiring, development, evaluation, coaching, prioritizing and celebrating our work.

We love our craft

We are passionate, curious, and inquisitive about our work. We have fun, infuse soulfulness, and don’t take ourselves too seriously. We pursue mastery, hold ourselves to high standards, and seek to define the best practices in our industry. We’re lifelong learners who grow by challenging ourselves and sharing skills with others.

We execute for results

We believe in doing the right things, not more things. We recognize that a great strategy is only an idea without excellent follow-through. So, we constantly ask “why” to understand every project’s place in the big picture, ground ideas pragmatically, and execute for results with a calculated blend of speed and quality.

We lead with integrity

At the core of our foundation is integrity—a commitment to kindness, honesty, and accountability. Our actions match our words. We operate with good intentions and build productive, positive relationships.

We foster open dialogue

We thrive in a culture of open dialogue. We actively give, receive, and seek honest, clear feedback, then find opportunities to act on it. Transparency is our guiding principle, where spirited debate is encouraged, feedback is constructive, and we commit to continual improvement.

We act as one team

Collaboration is our heartbeat. We avoid silos, embrace the interdependence of our roles, and understand that our collective strength is what makes us unique. Alignment towards shared goals keeps us productive and efficient. We celebrate our successes and support each other through challenges.

We are very excited about the opportunity of working with you! We look forward to hearing from you!

- The Kalungi Team

Kalungi is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workforce. Employment at Kalungi is based solely on a person's qualifications directly related to professional competence. Kalungi does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of age, color, creed, disability, gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Meet SlingshotAt Slingshot Aerospace, we're on a mission to make space safer and more secure for everyone.
jobs.description:
Meet Slingshot

At Slingshot Aerospace, we're on a mission to make space safer and more secure for everyone. Our work directly impacts global security, disaster response, climate monitoring, and the critical infrastructure that connects our world. We're a team of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers who believe that the next generation of space operations will be powered by better data and smarter software. We move fast, we're not afraid to fail, and we believe the best ideas can come from anywhere—whether you're in engineering, sales, product, or operations. If you want to work on something that truly matters, with people who care deeply about the impact we're making and help shape the future of an industry that's just getting started, you're in the right place.

What You’ll Be Launching

We're looking for a UX Researcher who thrives in complex problem spaces and cares deeply about creating seamless, effective, and meaningful experiences for users in high-stakes environments. In this role, you’ll be a key advocate for the voice of the user—championing research-driven design decisions across multiple product teams.

Depending on level and scope, UX Researchers may focus on:

  • Usability and Tactical Research – validating workflows and UI patterns
  • Strategic and Generative Research – surfacing new opportunities and behavioral trends
  • Research Ops and Enablement – building systems and frameworks for scalable research

At more senior levels, this role leads high-impact initiatives, contributes to product and business strategy, and advocates for research across the organization.

We're building a team of sharp, creative people who love solving hard problems. We value curiosity over ego, initiative over waiting for permission, and people who genuinely care about doing great work. Bring your expertise, your fresh ideas, and your drive—we'll bring the rocket fuel.

Your Mission (Should you choose to accept it)

Discovery & Study Design

  • Take ownership of end-to-end research studies, including scoping, participant recruitment, methodology selection, facilitation, and analysis, across the full product lifecycle.
  • Frame research questions that address product uncertainties and business goals in collaboration with product, design, engineering, and growth.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning by surfacing user needs, pain points, and opportunity areas grounded in data.

Research Execution & Insight Generation

  • Conduct mixed-methods research (e.g., interviews, usability tests, surveys, field studies, A/B testing, etc.) and synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights.
  • Support product teams with rapid evaluative testing, continuous discovery practices, and post-launch learnings.
  • Partner with data analysts and designers to triangulate findings and ensure insights reflect user behavior, attitudes, and context.

Influence & Integration

  • Translate insights into frameworks, personas, journey maps, or recommendations that support product decisions and roadmap prioritization.
  • Present findings clearly and persuasively to cross-functional teams, fostering a shared understanding of user needs.
  • Build empathy through storytelling, facilitated workshops, and embedded collaboration with teams.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with design, product, engineering, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure user insights are integrated into design and business processes.
  • Collaborate with research peers to refine internal methodologies, templates, and best practices.
  • Advocate for research and champion the voice of the user in key planning and product decisions, helping shape the culture of user-centered development.

Initiative & Work Ethic

  • Self-starter who takes ownership and proactively identifies research opportunities that drive value for both users and the business.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills; you follow through on commitments.
  • Willingness to dive deep into complex, technical domains (e.g., space systems, defense operations, satellite tracking)
  • Present and engaged with internal teams and external users, fostering trust and deep understanding.

Pre-flight Checklist

  • Must be eligible to obtain or maintain US Government Security Clearance, preference given for active TS Clearance.
  • 3+ years of experience in UX research or a related field (e.g., design research, HCI, behavioral science, product design) with increasing scope and autonomy.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Sociology, Design, or a related field. Advanced degrees are a plus as is continued learning through research training, behavioral science certifications, or academic coursework.
  • Experience planning and executing end-to-end studies across both generative and evaluative research methods.
  • Proven ability to influence decisions through clear insights, storytelling, and data alignment.

Bonus Cargo

  • Stakeholder collaboration and influence
  • Journey mapping, persona creation, and insight frameworks
  • Tool proficiency (Figma, Dovetail, UserTesting, Miro, Lyssna, etc.)
  • Research ops awareness (participant management, templates, tagging, documentation)
  • Flexible in approach—can balance rigor with scrappiness depending on context
  • Consistent learning mindset with strong awareness of UX trends, methods, and ethical research practices
  • Communication skills: excellence in verbal and written communication to drive the most effective exchange with stakeholders, including customers, partners, and investors
  • Business skills: acumen of business principles and decision making
  • Strong understanding and experience with design thinking, human centered design and the product development process
  • Domain experience in aerospace, geospatial tech, 3D visualization, or real-time decision tools is a plus

We're building a constellation here, not looking for identical satellites. Every member of the team brings different capabilities to the same mission. If your orbit intersects with ours and you're mission-ready, send it.

US-based Candidates: we are currently only able to hire residents of the following U.S. states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, RI, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV We are unable to consider candidates residing in other U.S. states at this time.

Internationally-based Candidates: we are currently only able to hire residents of the following locations: United Kingdom. We are unable to consider candidates residing in other countries at this time.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion are key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who share a passion for creating a safer, more connected world. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also national origin, citizenship, sex, color, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic that is part of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and we embrace individuality.

LearnLux is the leading provider of workplace financial wellbeing that blends fiduciary digital planning with access to one-on-one guidance from Certified Financial Planner™️ professionals. LearnLux's award-winning program equips employees with a financial plan to guide them through decision points like budgeting, paying down debt, electing benefits, understanding equity compensation, starting a family, buying a home, saving for retirement, and more. Advanced reporting keeps our partners in the know, and drives results like reduction in financial stress, increased productivity, reduced employee turnover, greater use of pretax products, on-time retirement, and healthcare savings. LearnLux members feel great about their money, allowing their work and wellbeing to thrive.

We’re a remote-first company, backed by prominent investors such as Ashton Kutcher’s fund Sound Ventures and Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff.

The Role

As LearnLux’s Enterprise Account Executive, you will serve as a key driver of our growth by leading strategic sales efforts with Fortune 1,000 and multinational employers. This hands-on role owns the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to presentation, proposal, and close. You’ll manage complex buying processes, build strong relationships with executive stakeholders, and position LearnLux as the leading financial wellbeing solution in the market.

You will be a critical contributor to how we scale revenue in a high-growth, B2B2C, enterprise-focused environment. This role is ideal for a consultative sales professional who thrives in relationship building, strategic account management, and closing high-value opportunities.

This is a full-time, remote position which will require 25-30% travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive net new revenue by owning the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Build and manage a strategic pipeline of Fortune 1000 and multinational employer prospects, leveraging both outbound and inbound sources.
  • Conduct consultative discovery to deeply understand prospect pain points and tailor LearnLux solutions to meet their unique business, benefits, and workforce needs.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, demos, and proposals to senior executives, including HR, Total Rewards, Benefits, and Procurement leaders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Client Success, Product, and Operations teams to ensure alignment and maximize success.
  • Navigate complex procurement and RFP processes, developing high-quality submissions with support from proposal and revenue operations teams.
  • Build trusted relationships with benefits consultants, brokers, and channel partners to increase awareness and influence in the market.
  • Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting within CRM.
  • Represent LearnLux at industry conferences, webinars, and client-facing events.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–7+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales or equivalent, ideally within employee benefits, Digital Health, HR tech, or fintech.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quota.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN).
  • Experience running complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across HR, Finance, and Procurement.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with C-level and senior HR/Benefits executives.
  • Comfortable navigating RFPs and procurement processes.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Familiarity with the benefits ecosystem and consultant/broker landscape is a plus.
  • Passion for improving employee wellbeing and making a meaningful impact.

Benefits

  • Remote-first company structure
  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • 401(k)
  • Mental wellbeing (Talkspace)
  • Financial wellbeing (LearnLux)
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years of service
  • A supportive, inclusive team culture
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth at a fast-growing startup at the cutting edge intersection of financial wellness and technology

Closing

LearnLux strives to be an inclusive workplace and values learning from and engaging across different perspectives. Women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and members of other minority or marginalized groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

LearnLux is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against candidates on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

We are committed to fostering an environment that embraces diversity and inclusion and are seeking candidates from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to join our team. If you are interested in this opportunity but not sure if you fit this role, please apply and include a note to let us know of your interest. We’re excited to speak with you about joining our team!

募集要項

業務内容

ROUTE06（ルートシックス）は、大手企業のビジネスモデル変革を支援するDXパートナーです。

エンタープライズ向けビジネスAPIプラットフォーム「Plain」の提供とアジャイルでの事業化支援によって商取引のプラットフォーム化を実現し、新たな企業価値を生み出すことに貢献します。

ROUTE06のバックエンドエンジニアは、価値提供先となる事業ドメインの横断的理解とそれに必要なコラボレーション、システムアーキテクチャの設計と開発、システムの信頼性向上やパフォーマンス改善、CI/CDの整備やオペレーション自動化などの開発生産性向上に向けた開発など、幅広い行動選択肢の中から、チームで相談しつつ適性/希望/需要に応じて柔軟に選択し、顧客企業やエンドユーザーにとって最適かつ最善なUXを提供できるよう開発を進めます。

必須要件

  • Webアプリケーションフレームワークでの実装経験
  • 中規模以上のプロダクトの開発・運用経験、また技術選定やコードベースを改善した経験
  • Gitなどのバージョン管理システムを利用したチームでの開発経験

歓迎要件

  • Ruby on RailsでWebアプリケーションを開発した経験

  • フロントエンド技術の基本的な知識 (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
  • コンテナ仮想化技術を使って開発・運用した経験
  • AWSの利用経験
  • パフォーマンスチューニングの経験
  • 中規模以上のアプリケーションのアーキテクチャ設計に関わった経験

技術環境

  • 開発言語: Ruby
  • フレームワーク: Ruby on Rails
  • データベース: PostgreSQLなど
  • その他の技術要素: AWS、GraphQL、Terraformなど

選考フロー

選考はすべてオンラインで実施します。日本各地からぜひご応募ください。

カジュアル面談→書類選考→面接→業務委託契約締結

雇用形態

勤務体系

  • 10時〜19時を基本とし、自由に選択していただけます

jobs.excerpt: Position: Director of Supply Chain Department: Supply Chain & Logistics Employer Company: EAK Distribution Reports To: COO / Integrator Job Type: Full Time, Remote Salary: Up to $4000 Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.
jobs.description:
Position: Director of Supply Chain
Department: Supply Chain & Logistics
Employer Company: EAK Distribution
Reports To: COO / Integrator
Job Type: Full Time, Remote
Salary: Up to $4000
Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.

Role (Overview of the Position)

The Director of Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for building and managing the end-to-end supply chain infrastructure that will scale HOME GROWN from ~$20M to $100M+ in revenue. This position owns the full physical flow of goods: raw material procurement (domestic and international), vendor management including overseas finished goods suppliers, production coordination with Heirloom Organics, inventory planning and demand forecasting, inbound/outbound logistics, and multi-channel fulfillment across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop (MCF and FBT), Shopify, Home Depot dropship, and future retail partners.

Reporting to the COO/Integrator, the Director of Supply Chain leads the logistics team, owns the supply chain budget, and serves as the primary driver of ERP selection and implementation. This role must build the systems, processes, and team capable of supporting 600+ SKUs within two years while maintaining a stockout rate below 1%.

This is not a maintenance role. The company is in a high-growth phase with expanding channels, a vertically integrated manufacturing facility, and plans to 5x revenue. The Director of Supply Chain must be someone who has built supply chain infrastructure at scale and thrives in environments where the playbook has not been written yet.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

Demand Planning & Inventory Strategy

  • Own the demand planning function across all channels and all SKUs (180 today, scaling to 600+ within two years).
  • Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts that integrate sales velocity, seasonality, promotional calendars, and channel expansion timelines.
  • Maintain a stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs while minimizing overstock and dead inventory.
  • Establish safety stock models, reorder points, and lead time buffers for each product category and channel.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Brand Management, andProduct Development to align forecasts with planned launches, promotions, and channel expansions.

Procurement & Vendor Management

  • Consolidate and own all procurement across entities: raw seeds (via Heirloom Organics), envelopes, mylars, soil, pots, packaging materials, and finished goods from overseas and domestic suppliers.
  • Manage international supplier relationships including overseas finished goods vendors: lead times, import logistics, customs/duties, and quality assurance.
  • Negotiate supplier contracts, pricing, lead times, and quality standards.
  • Build a diversified vendor base that reduces single-source risk as SKU count scales.
  • Manage purchase order workflows and ensure alignment between procurement spend and approved budgets.

Heirloom Organics Production Coordination

  • Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Mark (Operations Lead) and the Heirloom Organics team in Grants Pass, OR.
  • Translate demand forecasts into production requirements and ensure production schedules align with fulfillment timelines.
  • Track production output against commitments. Escalate and problem-solve when production falls behind plan.
  • Collaborate on capacity planning as SKU count and volume grow, including equipment utilization (seed counters, bag packers, labeling lines).

Logistics & Fulfillment

  • Oversee all inbound freight (vendor to warehouse/FBA/FBT) and outbound fulfillment operations.
  • Manage Amazon FBA compliance: IPI score maintenance (450+), restock limits, stranded inventory resolution, shipment plan optimization.
  • Manage TikTok Shop fulfillment across both Amazon MCF and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), including inventory allocation to TikTok warehouses.
  • Optimize B2C direct-to-consumer fulfillment for Shopify and TikTok orders. Determine when orders should ship from 3PL, Heirloom Organics directly, or FBA/FBT. Specifically optimize multi-unit order fulfillment to reduce per-unit shipping costs.
  • Oversee Home Depot dropship fulfillment and future retail channel logistics.
  • Optimize freight costs, carrier relationships, and shipping workflows.
  • Manage 3PL relationships and evaluate when direct fulfillment from HO is more cost-effective.

ERP Selection & Implementation

  • Lead the supply chain workstream of ERP evaluation and selection (currently in evaluation phase).
  • Define requirements for inventory management, procurement, production planning, and order management modules.
  • Own the supply chain side of ERP implementation: data migration, workflow configuration, team training, and go-live execution.
  • Ensure the ERP delivers real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Budget & Cost Management

  • Own the full supply chain budget: freight, raw materials, packaging, 3PL costs, and logistics overhead.
  • Track spend against budget with no more than +/-5% variance.
  • Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities across freight, procurement, and fulfillment without compromising service levels.
  • Report on supply chain unit economics and COGS trends to the COO and Controller.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage Asad (Logistics Manager) and Faiqa (Logistics Analyst).
  • Provide oversight and evaluation of Ather (Logistics Coordinator) and Faisal to assess fit and readiness for scale.
  • Assess the current team structure and capabilities against the requirements of a 600+ SKU, $100M operation. Identify gaps and build a hiring plan.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with all direct reports. Establish clear KPIs and accountability for each role.
  • Foster a culture of operational discipline, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Results (Expected Accomplishments)

Inventory & Availability

  • Maintain stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs and channels.
  • Achieve demand forecast accuracy of 85%+ within the first 12 months.
  • Maintain Amazon IPI score at 450+ consistently.
  • Establish forward visibility of 8+ weeks on potential stockouts.

Procurement & Cost

  • Consolidate all procurement under a single function within the first 90 days.
  • Maintain or improve COGS as a percentage of revenue versus prior year.
  • Maintain supply chain budget within +/-5% variance.

Systems & Infrastructure

  • Complete ERP evaluation and selection within the first 90 days.
  • Lead supply chain ERP implementation to go-live.
  • Deliver real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Heirloom Organics Alignment

  • Establish a weekly production alignment cadence with Heirloom Organics within the first 30 days.
  • Achieve 90%+ production schedule adherence against demand-driven production plans.

Team & Operational Readiness

  • Complete a team assessment within 60 days: document capabilities, gaps, and a hiring/development plan for scaling to 600+ SKUs.
  • 100% of direct reports have documented roles (4R documents), clear KPIs, and weekly 1:1s.
  • Fulfillment SLA compliance at 98%+ across all channels.

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

Experience

  • 7+ years in supply chain, logistics, or operations management with at least 3 years in a senior/director-level role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing supply chains with hundreds of SKUs and complex raw material inputs (e-commerce or CPG strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience scaling supply chain infrastructure from ~$20M to $50M+ in revenue.
  • Track record of managing end-to-end supply chains: raw material procurement, finished goods sourcing (including international/overseas suppliers), inventory planning, fulfillment, and logistics.
  • Experience selecting and implementing ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Experience managing or closely coordinating with manufacturing/production operations.

Skills

  • Strong demand planning and inventory optimization capabilities. Comfortable building forecast models and safety stock frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of Amazon FBA operations: IPI management, restock limits, shipment planning, and stranded inventory.
  • Proficiency with supply chain analytics and reporting. Able to translate complex logistics data into clear leadership updates.
  • Vendor negotiation and contract management.
  • ERP/WMS/IMS fluency. Ability to define requirements, evaluate vendors, and lead implementation.
  • Budget ownership and P&L management experience.

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to build, assess, and develop logistics teams. Not just managing what is inherited, but evaluating talent for scale readiness and making hard calls.
  • Ability to influence cross-functionally, including production teams without a direct reporting line.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. Can operate effectively in a remote-first, async-heavy environment.
  • Systems thinker who can zoom out from daily execution to identify structural risks and build for scale.

Cultural Fit

  • Aligned with HOME GROWN core values: Radical Transparency, Disciplined Growth, Compounded Trust, Measured Decisions, Intentional Execution, Collective Excellence.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are being built, not maintained.
  • Comfortable with EOS methodology (L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, Accountability Charts).
  • Self-directed and accountable. Does not require micromanagement to deliver results.

Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

Success in this role requires working on two levels simultaneously: managing and developing channel partnerships - the service companies, systems integrators, and broadcast partners through whom deals are often structured and delivered, while also creating demand and building conviction at the top of the value chain with rights holders, leagues, federations, and executive decision-makers. You will be expected to be present at key live deployments, acting as the commercial face of Muybridge on-site, strengthening partner and client relationships in the field, and supporting the deployment team when needed.

This is a senior, self-sufficient role - one for someone equally comfortable in a boardroom and a broadcast truck. You will carry technical conversations with prospects, supported remotely by our technical team, and close enterprise-level deals that often span multiple decision-makers and long sales cycles. You report directly to the CCO.

What You'll Do

Revenue Generation & Channel Partner Development

  • Own and manage a structured European pipeline, forecasting accurately and reporting to the CCO on a regular cadence.
  • Meet and exceed an annual sales quota through a combination of new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.
  • Develop account plans for key strategic targets and execute against them with discipline and creativity.
  • Maintain a rigorous and up-to-date record of all conversations, opportunities, and account activity in the company's CRM system, ensuring full pipeline visibility for the leadership team.
  • Prepare, submit, and negotiate commercial proposals and offers, managing the full arc from initial qualification through to signed agreement.
  • Steer legal documents and partnership agreements to closure, working closely with the CCO and internal stakeholders to navigate complex contract structures and multi-party negotiations.
  • Conduct business and commercial modelling to assess deal economics, validate pricing structures, and ensure sustainable value creation for both Muybridge and its customers and partners.
  • Serve as the regional voice on market dynamics, competitor activity, pricing feedback, and emerging customer need.
  • Contribute to commercial strategy, proposal development, and partnership structuring discussions with the CCO and leadership team.

You will deploy this commercial approach across three priority verticals. The three verticals below represent Muybridge's current priority markets in order of revenue focus. As the platform scales, so will the addressable opportunity - spanning additional industries where computer vision and volumetric capture will reshape how content is created and consumed.

1. Sports Broadcast

  • Develop and close opportunities across the European sports broadcast ecosystem: leagues, federations, clubs, venues, host broadcasters, rights holders, production service partners, and technology partners.
  • Build and manage relationships with rights holders and broadcast partners across key sports properties.
  • Navigate complex multi-party value chains where technology, rights, and production responsibilities are distributed across several organisations.
  • Represent Muybridge at industry events, trade shows, and broadcast forums across the region.

2. Studio & Network Production

  • Identify and develop opportunities with TV networks, streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon, Apple TV+ and equivalents), and independent production companies with the intent of promoting and adopting a novel way to capture content that was previously impossible - unlocking new perspectives and introducing new forms of storytelling.
  • Target sports studios, news operations, scripted and unscripted productions, and film projects where the Muybridge platform creates a step-change in production value or workflow.
  • Build relationships with creative directors, heads of production, technical directors, and commissioning executives across broadcast and streaming.

3. Live Events & Entertainment

  • Develop pipeline across the live events sector: major music tours, festivals, arena entertainment, and high-profile cultural productions seeking next-generation capture capabilities.
  • Partner with promoters, venues, production companies, and brand experience agencies to integrate Muybridge technology into premium live productions.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–12 years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, or commercial partnerships within sports media, broadcast technology, studio production, or live entertainment, or a combination of these.
  • A proven track record of hitting and exceeding revenue targets in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, media, and live production — able to hold a credible technical conversation without engineering support in the room. A working understanding of broadcast workflows, signal chains, or production infrastructure is a meaningful advantage.
  • Existing network across European broadcasters, leagues, streaming platforms, or production companies is a strong advantage.
  • Experience selling novel or emerging technology into conservative or risk-averse buyers — you know how to build conviction around something new.
  • Highly self-directed: able to build pipeline from scratch, manage your own schedule, and operate without daily management support.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently across Europe and occasionally internationally.
  • Based in Western Europe; UK strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • These are the first dedicated commercial roles at Muybridge, and the people who fill them will form the core of the commercial leadership team as the company scales.
  • You will be a vital commercial presence in Europe for a technology that lives in a unique moment with no direct competitor and is deeply protected by patents — the category is yours to define.
  • You will work directly with the CCO and leadership team, with short decision-making cycles and real influence on commercial strategy.
  • You will close deals that appear in major broadcast productions and live events seen by millions.
  • Competitive base salary with a 50/50 performance-based structure designed to reward significant over-performance.
  • You will join at a pivotal moment - Series A closed, commercially proven, and ready to scale.

  • Be Humane.

  • Be Hungry.

  • Be Holistic.

Our first Product is a financial intelligence platform. The platform helps high-net-worth individuals (business owners, family offices, entrepreneurs, and athletes) manage their investments. Our 'Patrons' track everything from art to crypto to real estate and business assets.

The team comprises veterans who have been shipping products for decades; we've been designing and developing native iOS apps since the dawn of the iOS SDK. We've already unlocked early product-market fit, we're fully funded, and we have plenty of runway to match our ambitions.

The position is a "blue sky" space that will shape the future of our patron interactions. Our patrons come from a wide variety of backgrounds, with varying levels of expertise. A successful Concierge candidate will provide strategic oversight while onboarding patrons, ingesting documents, supporting/clarifying functionality, and working closely with other delivery teams.

About You

You are a social butterfly. You love supporting multi-disciplinary teams and harbor deep human empathy. You value autonomy and love being on a team where you contribute directly to the problem at hand. You love challenging assumptions and coming through for customers day in, day out.

Your Knowledge:

  • You have a good sense of humor and believe culture matters.

  • You love learning and want to be on a team that will challenge you and gives you the freedom to grow.

  • You're customer service-oriented with a natural tendency to take care of people.

  • You're free to travel within the United States up to 25% of the time.

Engaging Patrons:

  • You're comfortable under pressure, dealing with ultra-wealthy patrons.

  • You love leading a team and building inroads across disciplines.

  • You cherish delivering value for customers you interact with.

  • You demonstrate extraordinary patience and perseverance.

  • You know attention to detail and articulate communication is a must.

  • College/University degree or related work experience preferred.

  • Working knowledge of G-Suite, HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Slack, and any other applicable customer communication technology.

Notable Perks:

  • We're a distributed workforce with lots of experience working in remote teams. That said, we also know the importance of face-to-face. To that end, we host an annual Defrag onsite and allow employees to travel to the closest "hub" to mingle in between Defrags (within reason, pre-approval required).

  • Flexible hours. Most of the team is active during the day, but we don't have set hours. If you need to drop the kids off at school or grab groceries mid-day and would rather clock hours at night, that's cool by us. We recognize work-life balance and understand managing the modern family unit can be messy. We primarily operate in Mountain Time, so we ask that overlap occurs as much as possible for jamming and collaboration.

  • Fun matters, which is why we built "The Wheel of Fortuna," a prize wheel everyone gets to spin when we achieve our goals. It's also why we have weekly happy hours and regular "game nights."

  • Environment matters. You can work wherever you want. In a post COVID world, we plan to establish some office space where teams can come and go as they please, collaborating face to face as needed. We know environment matters, which is why every new hire gets a $1,000 office upgrade budget in addition to meeting their technology needs.

  • Health insurance. We provide competitive coverage for health, dental, vision, and life insurance in both the US and Canada. In the US specifically, we cover 75% of insurance.

  • Mental and physical health matters, which is why each employee is entitled to a $400/year stipend for gym/club/fitness-related membership. Also, we will reimburse you for an annual subscription to whatever meditation/mindfulness/wellness app you prefer.

If there's something that you're passionate about that also benefits the team, chances are we're going to approve it.

We believe that diversity and inclusion enable us to broaden our perspectives and build a more equitable future. We encourage applicants from all creeds, backgrounds, and walks of life to apply.

We're a band of innovators, designers, and technologists looking to simplify wealth and unlock unprecedented access for all investors. We pride ourselves on building idiomatic native experiences. We know design matters, and we know investing in pixel-perfection is worthwhile.

We believe you cannot over-invest in culture. We accept humans are poor substitutes for robots - we also understand humans are not resources.

Noë & Associates is a global brand consultancy working across real estate, hospitality, and luxury. We specialise in the unbuilt — creating brands and telling the stories of places before they exist. From our studios in New York, London, and Dubai, we have helped bring billions of dollars of developments to market for clients including Aman, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental, Jumeirah, and IHG.

The role

This is a craft role at the frontier. You trained in film and you think like a cinematographer — in composition, lens, light, movement, and pace — and you have carried that language into AI video, where the tools now let us show a place, a feeling, and a way of living long before anything is built.
You will work alongside our strategists, designers, editors, and producers to develop the look and feel of residences, resorts, and destinations still in design — turning a vision into something a client and their audience can actually see and feel.

What you’ll do

• Create cinematic film and motion with generative video tools — from early concept films to finished campaign work.

• Exercise judgement about tools — which model or approach serves a given shot, and when a result is genuinely good enough to ship.

• A real grounding in film. Film school or equivalent training, with genuine command of cinematic language, pacing, and storytelling — film specifically, not photography. You think in motion, and you know how a single shot lives within a sequence.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Fusion Growth Partners

We are seeking very high-level sales executives to sell the best opportunity for Residential Real Estate Agents who want to truly scale their personal production and teams, that currently exist or has existed.

Fusion Growth Partners is a dynamic business incubator and micro venture capital firm. We identify and invest in small, service-based businesses, particularly individual real estate agents, who have a strong track record but are often overlooked by traditional investors. Our unique "Partnership as a Service" model involves investing heavily in their businesses to boost their clientele significantly and scale profits. We're proud to have been ranked among Inc. 5000's fastest-growing businesses (813th nationally), making this an unparalleled opportunity for ambitious sales professional business advisors.

Our partners gain access to sophisticated growth planning, a full suite of back-office services, cutting-edge SaaS resources, and the dedicated support of our experienced team. Fusion is the only company in the country offering these services with a compensation structure specifically designed to accommodate the cash flow needs of real estate agents. With over 300 team members and rapid expansion, we're now seeking top talent to help us penetrate new markets.

Fusion's income is primarily generated from a small share of the revenue our partners' businesses generate. We're looking to hire additional Partnership Executives to support our rapidly growing volume of new partnership investments.

Your Mission as a Partnership Executive: Forge Partnerships, Then Cultivate Growth

As a Partnership Executive at Fusion Growth Partners, your journey begins with a focused inside sales approach, identifying and acquiring new business investment partnerships. This initial phase is crucial for building your foundation.

Initial Focus: Investment / Partner Acquisition (Inside Sales). Your primary responsibility will be to qualify potential business candidates and provide a detailed, personal explanation of our unique investment model. This involves actively reaching out, presenting our services, and engaging in compelling conversations to identify ideal partners. This is not an easy job and it is only for those individuals who desire to be challenged and want to develop their skills as a business person.

Once you have proven yourself as someone who is dedicated, effective and willing to do the discipline work of business development and sales, you will have several different growth and promotion opportunities.

Growth & Promotion Opportunities are as follows:

1. Contract Negotiator – This position is held for those who are exceptional at closing deals. Our sales cycle comprises two primary meetings, both typically held on Zoom. The first is our Explanation of Investment. If the potential client is interested in our services, we then conduct what we call a “Make A Deal” meeting. This meeting brings us together with the client with the intent of reaching an agreement and executing it in a single meeting. These meetings can feel somewhat like a “Shark Tank” scenario, but with a more collaborative approach. Our top negotiators are promoted to run these meetings exclusively for the other executives. We call them “Heroes.” Our close ratio at this stage is over 50%.

2. Consultant / Business Coach – This position allows you to build your own book of clients by providing advisory services and coaching agents to get the most out of the systems we offer. One reason we ensure you have very strong sales skills before promoting you into this role is that it requires a high level of influence. You must be able to guide agents to take actions that will benefit their business, even when those actions do not provide immediate gratification. This role requires leadership influence and the ability to articulate concepts clearly, ideas, and business philosophies so they are well understood. It also requires holding highly driven individuals accountable for doing what is necessary to achieve their goals and ambitions.

Business Advisor & Partnership Management (Consultant Role)– As partners are acquired through your sales efforts and through the efforts of other team members who have not yet been promoted, those partners will be assigned to your portfolio. At that point, your role quickly shifts into that of a consultant, where you act as a “board member” or trusted advisor to the business owner. You will be intensely focused on the success and business growth of each partner you serve, encouraging best practices and promoting full adoption of our systems to maximize their likelihood of success. As an executive, you are responsible for the partner’s experience and business success in partnership with Fusion. While Fusion provides a team of individuals to work on the client’s behalf, you, as the Partnership Executive, must drive and advocate for that success. Real estate agents join us to scale their operations, and it is your responsibility to ensure that happens.

3. Vice President– For those who demonstrate strong leadership ability in the advisory role and the capability to effectively grow agents’ businesses, there is an opportunity to move into a leadership position. In this role, you will help recruit, train, and mentor other Partnership Executives within your own business division and earn an override on all clients under your umbrella.

This commission-based, revenue-sharing position offers a typical starting income of $70,000 annually. As you successfully acquire partners and your "book of business" expands, you can realistically earn $250,000 annually or more within the first three years. We're only looking for exceptionally talented individuals who can help us grow and represent Fusion at the highest levels of professionalism.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a polished professional with highly effective communication skills. You should be very persuasive but not "salesy," comfortable with difficult conversations, and able to tackle challenges head-on. A successful candidate will confidently present ideas and concepts.

We are looking for people who thrive in sales! Those who say to themselves “give me the ball”. You must be willing to make the calls and do follow up consistently in the first part of this journey and this is something that should not be distasteful to you or something that you dread. In fact this is something that you are compelled to share the opportunity and you genuinely cannot wait to share it with people who you can encourage to listen to what you have to share. This must be something that you have the ability and the discipline to do at a high level without someone to micro manage your day.

As an advisor or as a negotiator, you must be able to work with very strong-willed individuals and guide them to embrace Fusion’s unique perspective, which they will embrace over time. While experience in the residential real estate industry is helpful, it is not required.

We'll provide extensive training on our go-to-market strategy, business philosophies, and our unique systems and processes. Explore our website at:


Requirements

  • Possess a "fanatical obsession" with Business Development, Prospecting and effective sales
  • Possess a "fanatical obsession" with the success of every single client you manage.
  • Possess a "fanatical obsession" with doing the best you can for everyone on your team.

  • A true servant leader.

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    We're hiring a Staff Data Scientist, Core Revenue Retention to own one outcome — keeping and growing revenue from existing customers — across every team that shapes it. Revenue retention isn't the property of a single product: it spans CPaaS (phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp) as our largest MRR surface, add-on monetization including emerging AI features, the Customer Success motions that protect accounts, and Finance's forecasts.

    This is a broad, cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Communications/CPaaS, Customer Success, the AI teams pursuing add-on revenue, Finance, and other revenue-driving product teams; you report centrally to Product Analytics & Data Science for craft and standards and carry the revenue-retention outcome across organizational boundaries. You'll build the retention/value model, separate real churn signal from data-maturity and mix artifacts, and turn diagnosis into a prioritized, evidence-based retention and add-on-monetization agenda. You'll work amid a data foundation still being built, consuming governed sources rather than rebuilding them, and raising the bar as you go. This is a hands-on, direction-setting Staff role — you advise Customer Success, Finance, and CPaaS leaders and set retention-measurement standards that analysts on adjacent teams adopt, with a path to grow a pod as the mandate scales.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the causal read on core revenue retention and add-on monetization — gross and net revenue retention, MRR churn (voluntary vs involuntary), attach and usage of add-ons — across CPaaS, AI add-ons, and other revenue surfaces
  • Quantify add-on revenue opportunity across CPaaS and emerging AI features, and the drivers behind attach and consumption
  • Apply rigorous causal inference (matching, diff-in-diff, survival/hazard, synthetic control) where clean experiments aren't feasible — separating real signal from selection bias, seasonality, and mix
  • Partner with Finance/RevOps on single-source-of-truth definitions and forecasting inputs; drive the revenue-retention insights
  • Partner with the Product Strategy & Growth org on the TTP/churn charter, and with the Experimentation lead to test retention interventions rigorously
  • Act as a trusted analytical advisor to Customer Success, Finance, and Communications/CPaaS leaders, and set the analytical standards that DS and analysts on adjacent teams adopt — raising the bar without direct authority
  • Set the technical direction for how revenue retention is measured company-wide — own the canonical GRR/NRR, churn, and add-on metrics on governed, certified data that other teams build on; shape the taxonomy retention analytics depends on with Analytics Engineering
  • Build the retention and causal-inference framework — the standards and reusable methods (survival/hazard, diff-in-diff, synthetic control) that Analytics Engineering and adjacent DS teams reuse beyond this mandate
  • Use AI tooling (Claude and similar) to move faster on exploration, documentation, and analysis

Requirements:

  • 9+ years in revenue/retention analytics, data science, or applied statistics, with deep experience on churn, retention, and monetization
  • Practical causal inference with sound judgment about when a result is causal vs. an artifact of how the data was generated
  • Comfort untangling messy financial/billing/usage data and defining metrics that survive scrutiny from Finance and product alike
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python; comfort in a Snowflake + dbt environment
  • Track record where a retention or monetization diagnosis changed a product, pricing, CS, or lifecycle decision
  • Comfort amid imperfect, in-progress data — you consume governed sources and raise the bar rather than rebuilding pipelines
  • Cross-functional influence — you align product, Customer Success, Finance, and leadership on shared numbers without direct authority

Nice to Have:

  • CPaaS (telephony/messaging) or usage-based/consumption revenue experience
  • B2B SaaS or CRM background; experience with MRR/subscription billing, dunning, and involuntary-churn recovery
  • Familiarity with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics workflows; experience mentoring analysts

Success in this role looks like:

  • CPaaS, AI add-ons, and Customer Success act on your model, and drives strong positive business results.
  • Finance/RevOps and Product Analytics report the consistent metrics with clear insight and recommendations.
  • Leaders across the revenue domain make roadmap and spend calls off your analysis, not gut feel
  • The revenue-retention mandate has reusable patterns and the foundation to scale beyond one IC
